comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus hand-fit an oil filter.
comparison.physical_skill: Setscrew access, fine collar tuning, and dynamic feedback versus coaxial thread engagement and bounded hand rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Non-bottoming, low-rebound impacts with lock retention versus gasket contact followed by a specified tightening angle without removal or over-tightening.
comparison.reason: Controlled rotation is generic; dynamic tuning and thread/gasket installation are meaningfully different. Candidate final tolerances are incomplete.
